metadata.name: drawsol
metadata.description: DrawSol v3 - pot and headline prize draws with ORAO VRF instant wins

instructions.name: buy_tickets
docs: Buys `quantity` tickets as one entry, `use_credits` of them paid with credits.
Pot draws with instant tiers request the entry's ORAO randomness.

accounts.name: buyer
docs: Pays the tickets, the ORAO fee (pot draws) and rent; becomes the entry owner.

accounts.name: vrf_request
docs: checked in `request_randomness` and created by the ORAO CPI (`init`, so never reused).

instructions.name: cancel_draw
docs: Permissionless. Cancels a draw whose randomness never arrived (after the grace period).

instructions.name: claim_free_entry
docs: One free ticket per wallet, up to `free_cap`. Rolls for instant wins in pot draws.

accounts.name: buyer
docs: The claiming wallet (pays rent and, in pot draws, the ORAO fee; becomes the entry owner).

instructions.name: claim_refund
docs: Permissionless. Refunds an entry of a cancelled draw (paid − instant SOL received; credits back).

instructions.name: create_headline_draw
docs: Admin only. Headline draw; escrows the prize. Enforces sell-out house share and the floor margin.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Pays rent and escrows the prize.

instructions.name: create_pot_draw
docs: Admin or keeper. Nightly pot draw; no escrow. Enforces the house/pot/instant split bounds.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Admin or keeper; pays rent only (no escrow).

instructions.name: init_config
docs: Fresh deployments: creates the v3 Config. Signer must be the program's upgrade authority.

instructions.name: legacy_close_v2
docs: Admin only. Closes an empty or fully settled v2 draw + vault (raw-byte parse) into the admin.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Receives every lamport of the v2 draw and vault.

instructions.name: migrate_config
docs: Admin only. Reallocs the v2 Config into the v3 layout and sets the keeper.

accounts.name: config
docs: owner, discriminator and length checked in the handler.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Must be the admin stored in the v2 Config. Pays the extra rent.

instructions.name: request_draw
docs: At draw_at: keeper/authority first, anyone after the public grace. Requests the grand-draw
randomness, or cancels (no tickets / headline below min_tickets).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the ORAO fee; must be the keeper or the authority during the grace window.

accounts.name: vrf_request
docs: Not needed when the draw is cancelled here (no tickets / headline undersold).

instructions.name: reveal_entry
docs: Permissionless. Computes a pot entry's instant results and pays them from the instant pool.

accounts.name: profile
docs: Receives credit prizes.

instructions.name: self_exclude
docs: Self-exclusion until `until` (unix seconds); can only be extended.

instructions.name: set_keeper
docs: Admin only.

instructions.name: set_limit
docs: Spend limit per 30 days (0 = none). Decrease now, increase after 72 h.

instructions.name: settle_draw
docs: Permissionless. Pays the prize to the owner of the entry holding the winning ticket.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Authority only. House share after settlement; a cancelled headline's escrow.

types.name: CommonDrawParams
docs: Parameters shared by both draw kinds.

types.name: Config
docs: seeds = [b"config"]
v3 layout. The v2 layout was `admin, next_draw_id, bump` (8 + 41 bytes, same discriminator);
`migrate_config` reallocs a v2 Config into this layout.

fields.name: keeper
docs: Low-trust automation key: may create pot draws and request draws during the public-grace window.

types.name: DrawCancelled
docs: reason: 0 = no tickets, 1 = randomness timeout, 2 = headline undersold (below min_tickets)

fields.name: prize_lamports
docs: headline: escrowed prize; pot: 0

types.name: DrawV3
docs: seeds = [b"draw3", id.to_le_bytes()]

fields.name: authority
docs: config.admin at creation; receives the house share / returned escrow

fields.name: ticket_cap
docs: paid tickets (free and credit tickets never count)

fields.name: max_per_wallet
docs: all ticket kinds

fields.name: draw_at
docs: >= closes_at; sell-out ends sales early, the draw still waits for draw_at

fields.name: public_grace_secs
docs: only keeper/authority may request the draw during [draw_at, draw_at + grace)

fields.name: prize_lamports
docs: headline: fixed escrow; pot: 0 until settled (then the prize actually computed)

fields.name: min_tickets
docs: headline only

fields.name: floor_margin_bps
docs: headline only

fields.name: pot_lamports
docs: pot draws: accumulated pot share

fields.name: instant_pool_lamports
docs: pot draws: current instant pool balance

fields.name: revenue_lamports
docs: every lamport paid for tickets

fields.name: next_ticket
docs: ticket numbers are 0..next_ticket (all kinds)

fields.name: rolled_entries
docs: entries that need a reveal (have an ORAO request)

fields.name: prize_paid
docs: prize disbursed: to the winner (Settled) or the escrow back to the authority (Cancelled headline)

types.name: EntryV3
docs: seeds = [b"entry3", draw.key(), seq.to_le_bytes()] where seq = draw.entry_count at creation.

fields.name: count
docs: paid + credit (+1 for a free entry)

fields.name: pool_snapshot
docs: pot draws: `instant_pool_lamports` right after this purchase's contribution

fields.name: vrf_request
docs: ORAO randomness request PDA (default when the entry has no roll)

fields.name: tiers
docs: per ticket: 0 = no win, 1..=4 = tier index + 1

fields.name: sol_paid
docs: instant SOL actually paid

types.name: IwTierV3
docs: One instant-win tier. Unused = all zero.

fields.name: odds
docs: winning outcomes out of `iw_denominator`

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 none, 1 sol_share, 2 credits

fields.name: value
docs: sol_share: bps of the entry's pool snapshot; credits: free-ticket credits

fields.name: pending_from
docs: 0 = nothing pending

fields.name: num_received
docs: Total number of received requests.

fields.name: mint
docs: ORAO token mint address.

fields.name: treasury
docs: ORAO token treasury account.

fields.name: fee
docs: Fee in ORAO SPL token smallest units.

types.name: PlayerV3
docs: seeds = [b"player3", draw.key(), wallet]

fields.name: tickets
docs: all kinds (paid + credit + free)

fields.name: paid
docs: lamports paid for tickets

fields.name: iw_denominator
docs: 0 = no instant wins (all tiers must then be unused)

types.name: Profile
docs: seeds = [b"profile", wallet]. Global across draws.

fields.name: credits
docs: free-ticket credits (won as instant prizes, spent with `use_credits`)

fields.name: limit_lamports
docs: 0 = no limit

fields.name: pending_from
docs: 0 = no pending change; otherwise `pending_limit` applies from this time

fields.name: pot_lamports
docs: pot draws: the draw's pot / instant pool after this purchase

types.name: VaultV3
docs: seeds = [b"vault3", draw.key()]. Program-owned, no fields: its lamports are everything the draw holds.
Debited directly by the program; it always stays rent-exempt.
